note: Clinical AI for medical imaging, Tel Aviv. TCV's own post (2022-07) announces its investment at the $110M Series D of June 2022 (General Catalyst led). The $150M Series E of April 2026 (Goldman Sachs Alternatives led; PR Newswire) disclosed no valuation, and no priced figure of $1B or more is on record, so the row reads below $1B (Rule A; aligned with General Catalyst). Momentum slice checked 2026-09-29.

UK SME bank, London. TCV's own post of 2022-12-05 announces its investment, the £100M Series C (Tech.eu, 2022-12-07). Mark: the $155M Series D of 2026-02-25 at 'nearly $1.2 billion' (Pulse 2.0; Finextra 'hits unicorn status'), with TCV and Blue Owl as longstanding backers.

Construction lending software, Nashville. TCV led the $125M Series D as a new investor (the firm's own post, 2021-09), valuing Built at $1.5B (Commercial Observer, 2021-09-30); the Form D band's 'Series A' read a later filing.

Enterprise HR software, Hyderabad. TCV led the $72M round of January 2022 at $1B+ (the Series D; the firm's own post). The $140M round co-led by Partners Group and KKR (2025-03-05) values Darwinbox 'at more than $1 billion' (Bloomberg): the figure is recorded as that floor, $1.0B, flagged for review (Coatue R4, a floor under the valuation).

Dream11's parent, Mumbai. Last priced round: $840M at $8B (November 2021). India banned real-money gaming from 2025-10-01; paid contests were about 95% of revenue and all of the profit, and Dream11 stopped them (Business Standard, 2025-08-26), pivoting to free play and advertising. Run-time ruling R3 (flagged): a law ending the business's core is collapse evidence of the same weight as the sale of the core, so the stale 2021 mark does not band the row; no new priced event exists.

FlixBus, FlixTrain and Greyhound (Flix SE), Munich. TCV and Permira led the funding round of July 2019 (the firm's own copy of the release). Mark: EQT Future and Kühne Holding bought 35% for about EUR 1B in a deal valuing Flix at more than EUR 3B (announced 2024-07-04, closed 2024-11-28; a capital increase plus shares from existing investors), recorded at the EUR 3B floor. | EUR 3.00B @ ECB 2024-07-04 (EUR/USD 1.08) = $3.24B

Creator commerce platform, Amsterdam (founded in Belo Horizonte). TCV led the $130M investment round of April 2021 (Business Wire), which Leaders League reports as the R$735M Series C: Growth. No valuation was disclosed by the company or the press; the $1B figure in vendor profiles (PitchBook) stays in this note (Rule A).

Travel experiences platform, Hong Kong. On the compliance list from 2018, the year of the $200M Series D (Growth). Klook filed an F-1 for a NYSE listing (KLK) in November 2025 and has not priced (StockAnalysis: 'Pending IPO', 2026-09-29), so it is private; mark: the SoftBank Vision Fund-led $225M round of April 2019 at over $1B (KrASIA), stale.

Grid digital twin for utilities (Linesoft Pty Ltd dba Neara), Sydney. TCV led the A$90M Series D of February 2026 at A$1.1B (pv magazine Australia; Kurrant: 'A$1.1B valuation, A$90M Series D'), a 'unicorn' in Australian dollars that converts below $1B at the ECB rate of the day. | AUD 1.10B @ ECB 2026-02-10 (AUD/EUR 1.683, EUR/USD 1.1894) = $777.4M

Instructional content for schools, New York. TCV led the $50M Series C (the firm's own copy of the release, 2019-03-13) and co-led the $100M Series D of February 2021 with Franklin Templeton at $1B (EdWeek Market Brief).

Retail planning software (RELEX Oy), Helsinki. TCV's $200M investment of February 2019 (the firm's own post) was the first outside capital: Growth.
